display.purpose: The attendance clock only. Tabular numerals, tight tracking. Open shifts use brand text.

headline.purpose: Short screen titles such as sign-in and signup.

title.purpose: Card titles. The week control date is the same tight semibold at 15px.

body.purpose: The page default. Card copy and hints use 0.875rem with a 1.5rem line.

label.purpose: Buttons, fields, tabs, and form labels. Day names step down to 0.75rem.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Cards, primary and quiet buttons, the selected tab, the week board, and person chips, at rest. Dark theme: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 8px 16px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45).

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Menus, the date picker, settings, and the sign-in card. Dark theme: 0 12px 28px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Color, background, border, shadow, opacity, and transform on buttons, links, fields, selects, and tabs. A press scales to 0.97. Reduced motion drops the scale and keeps the color change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The brand action: save, publish, and the attendance punch. The punch uses the same colors at 48px tall.

components.css: .ds-chrome{width:100%;max-width:640px;font-family:Heebo, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif}.ds-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--brand,#2b5bff);padding:10px 16px}.ds-logo-plate{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:32px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--card,#fffdf8);color:var(--ink,#1c1917);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-tabbar{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--page,#f4f0e6) 85%,transparent);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e6dfd2);padding:8px 16px}.ds-tabs{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e6dfd2);border-radius:8px;background:var(--track,#e7e0d2)}.ds-tab{min-height:36px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#57534e);font-family:inherit;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.25rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1),color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1),transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)}.ds-tab:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--card,#fffdf8) 50%,transparent);color:var(--ink,#1c1917)}.ds-tab-on,.ds-tab-on:hover{background:var(--card,#fffdf8);color:var(--ink,#1c1917);font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(28 25 23 / 0.05), 0 8px 16px -10px rgb(28 25 23 / 0.18)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2b5bff);outline-offset:2px}.ds-tab:active{transform:scale(.97)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-press:active { transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Rota reads as a warm paper week. The page is a light sheet, cards are a slightly brighter cream, and the type is near-black. Heebo carries Hebrew and Latin, so both languages share one size, weight, and color. A solid brand bar holds the existing wordmark on a paper chip and the site control. Under the bar, a standard tab strip sits on the paper. The week itself is a row of seven columns.

Today is the only column drawn in brand ink, with a brand tick under the day name. The other days keep ordinary ink and a hairline tick. On the employee home the clock is the large figure, and an open shift turns that clock to brand text. Morning, afternoon, and night keep their own colors. Controls stay ordinary buttons, tabs, fields, selects, and tables. A press scales to 0.97 and eases out. The same chrome means the same thing for an owner, a manager, and an employee.

The dark theme turns the page to the near-black of light-theme ink, lifts cards one warm step, and sets type in a warm off-white. Brand blue stays the same blue. Brand text lightens so today and an open clock stay readable on the night card. The confirmed rejection is a grey page with a single blue button: the bar is brand, and the page stays paper.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper page, cream cards, and near-black ink, with a dark theme that swaps those roles
A solid brand bar, and the existing wordmark on a paper chip
Today's weekday column, and an open attendance clock, are the brand-ink signatures
Morning, afternoon, and night stay data colors
Standard buttons, tabs, fields, selects, and tables, with an 8px corner and a 0.97 press

rules.name: The Today Column Rule
rules.body: Only the current weekday column is set in brand ink, with a brand tick under the name. Every other day keeps ordinary ink and a 1px field-line tick.

rules.name: The Open Clock Rule
rules.body: An open attendance clock is set in brand text. A closed clock stays in ink.

rules.name: The Data Color Rule
rules.body: Morning, afternoon, and night keep their shift dot and slot fill. Brand blue is not a shift color.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Heebo sets Hebrew and Latin at the same sizes and weights. Clock times and shift hours use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Shared Measure Rule
rules.body: The shell, the tab strip, and the work area share one centered measure, 1440px, with 16px of side padding that becomes 24px from the small breakpoint.

rules.name: The Clock Direction Rule
rules.body: Clock times, shift hours, and time fields stay left to right on a Hebrew page, so the digits do not mirror.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is a warm tonal step plus a soft downward shadow. Shadows are blurred and ink-tinted in light, black and heavier in dark.

rules.name: The Eight-Pixel Rule
rules.body: Buttons, fields, cards, tabs, and the week board use an 8px corner. Status chips are pills. The wordmark chip is the tighter 6px corner.

rules.name: The Paper Chip Rule
rules.body: The shell is a solid brand bar. The wordmark sits on a card-colored chip so the mark stays whole.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: A pressed control scales to 0.97 and eases with cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) over 140ms. Reduced motion drops the scale and keeps the color change.

dos: Do keep the shell a solid brand bar and set the existing wordmark on a card-colored chip.
Do mark only today's weekday column in brand text, with a brand tick, and give every other day a 1px field-line tick.
Do set an open attendance clock in brand text and a closed clock in ink.
Do set Hebrew and Latin in Heebo, and set clock times and shift hours in tabular numerals that stay left to right.
Do use the 8px corner on buttons, fields, cards, tabs, and the week board, and the soft card and pop shadows.
Do scale a press to 0.97 over 140ms with cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), and drop only the scale when motion is reduced.
Do keep morning, afternoon, and night on their shift dot and slot fill.
donts: Don't make the page a neutral grey with brand blue used only on one button.
Don't color a morning, afternoon, or night shift with brand blue.
Don't redraw the wordmark. The existing mark sits on the paper chip.
Don't set every weekday column in brand ink.
Don't use a hard, unblurred offset shadow. Shadows stay the soft card and pop shadows.
Don't scale a press when the user prefers reduced motion.
